neighbours.label: formal prose naming the ground or standard for something: the word completing 'on the basis of <criteria>', 'according to a <definition>', 'based on a <donation>', 'in the same manner that'
fire: The old town was added to the register of protected sites on the basis of criteria (ii) and (v).
A database is a collection which, according to a widely used definition, is organised for retrieval.
The scholarship was founded in 1961 based on a gift from a shipping company.
The surgeon must disclose the alternatives in the same manner that a careful peer would.
The reserve was placed on the international list on the basis of criteria (vii) and (x).
A sonnet is a poem which, according to a traditional definition, has fourteen lines.
The lecture series was begun in 1934 based on an endowment from the founder's widow.
The trustee must manage the assets in the same manner that a prudent investor would.
quiet: The old town was added to the register of protected sites after a long campaign.
A database is a collection of records that is organised for retrieval.
The scholarship was founded in 1961 and is open to students of any age.
The surgeon must disclose the alternatives before the patient signs the form.
The reserve was placed on the international list three years after it opened.
A sonnet is a poem of fourteen lines with a fixed rhyme scheme.
The lecture series was begun in 1934 and still runs every autumn.
The trustee must manage the assets and report to the family each year.
